: So, are we going to talk about what just happened?

lines.en: : Nope.

lines.en: : I think the sex part’s become so normal in my everyday life that I often just omit it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得性这件事在我的日常生活里已经平常到我会直接省略不提了。

lines.en: : I see now why you’ve become such a depressing mess over the last few months. I can only imagine how miserable {i}I{/i} would be if I got to bone Niki Nakayama whenever I wanted. Sounds like hell.
lines.zh: : 我现在明白你这几个月怎么变成这么一个丧气鬼了。我要是随时都能上 Niki Nakayama，{i}我{/i}大概也会惨成什么样——听起来简直是地狱。

lines.en: : Nope. Doesn’t count. What I did back there was no different than just watching porn and I hereby reclaim any innocence I may have lost in doing so. Thank you.

lines.en: : So, when you were fingering yourself, were you thinking more about {i}her{/i} or-

lines.en: scene otohamcds10

lines.en: : I used my other hand for that. And it’s not my goal to {i}collect bodies.{/i} If that’s what I cared about, I wouldn’t have rejected ten million people at my last school.
lines.zh: : 那只手我用的是另一只。而且我的目标也不是{i}收集身体{/i}。我要是在乎那个，我在上一所学校就不会拒绝掉一千万个人了。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Sometimes I forget how popular you were back then since the only person you ever hang out with {i}now{/i} is Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我有时候会忘了你当年有多受欢迎，毕竟你{i}现在{/i}唯一还会一起玩的人就是 Nodoka。

lines.en: scene otohamcds11

lines.en: : Silly me for thinking you’d keep your eyes on, oh- I don’t know, the girl you were having sex with?
lines.zh: : 我真是傻，居然以为你会把眼睛盯着——我也不知道——那个正在跟你做爱的女孩？

lines.en: : It’s like you said about Niki, I might never get to see you in another position like that for as long as I live.
lines.zh: : 就像你评价 Niki 时说的那样，我这辈子可能再也看不到你摆出那种姿态了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you haven’t had a crush on me for years like I have with her.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你又没像我喜欢她那样，喜欢了我好几年。

lines.en: : What if I had, though? But I’m just really bad at expressing myself and could never figure out how to tell you that {i}you’re{/i} the one I want out of everyone in Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 那要是我喜欢了呢？只不过我特别不擅长表达，一直不知道该怎么告诉你，在 Kumon-mi 的所有人里，我想要的是{i}你{/i}？

lines.en: scene otohamcds13

lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃不。

lines.en: : Man, I really hope you let down those millions of girls a lot gentler than that.

lines.en: : And I really hope that we can figure out a way to put this behind us and file it in whatever drawer we’re keeping the hotel sex-fest in.

lines.en: : Unfortunately for you, I keep all of my secrets in a single drawer that doesn’t even lock. And it’s only a matter of time until someone else finds out whether we want them to or not.

lines.en: : I know a solution to this.

lines.en: : You definitely don’t.

lines.zh: : 行啊。等你操她的时候告诉我一声，我立马就到。

lines.en: : Why do you know that?

lines.zh: : 大概因为她的处境跟我也差不了多少。

lines.zh: : 还有就是你失踪之后，她整个人变得超级古怪，动不动就发脾气。

lines.en: : Like, just the other day, I-

lines.en: Well, it appears that I have, once again, lost a chunk of the day to whatever higher power decided to extract it from me this time.
lines.zh: 看来我又一次把一整天的一大块时间丢给了那个这次决定从我身上抽走它、随便什么更高的存在。

lines.en: And while that’s fine and all considering it brings me one step closer to pulling the covers over my head again, I’d like for them to stop screwing around and just take me back to nighttime already.

lines.en: Everything else, though? Fuck it. Like, not literally. Okay, maybe a little literally. But not like literally a little literally. You know? Fuck it. Literally. Just not because I can’t even control when I get hard anymore.

lines.en: It either happens or it doesn’t. And when it does, it’s violent. But when it doesn’t, it’s nothing. It’s like, numb. It’s like, I can’t even describe it. It’s just numb. It’s either violent or it’s numb. Sex. You know?

lines.en: : So...what were we talking about just now?

lines.zh: : 不……不是那样。更像是……好奇吧，大概？还有……也许是屈服？

lines.en: : Like, I don’t want to say I was just {i}settling{/i} for Rin because anything with Niki seemed like such a long shot. But that’s also...{i}kind of{/i} what it was?
lines.zh: : 就是，我不想说我是因为在 Niki 那边看来太没戏，才{i}将就{/i}了 Rin。但那也{i}有点{/i}是这么回事？

lines.en: : But not in the sense where it, like...makes {i}her{/i} look bad. Because she was great. And I {i}do{/i} like her, just...not {i}like{/i} that.
lines.zh: : 不过不是在那种会让她显得很差的意思上。因为她很好。我{i}确实{/i}喜欢她，只是……不是{i}那种{/i}喜欢。

lines.en: : It was more like...trying to bring myself back to reality or...whatever. Shooting for something achievable for once instead of always keeping my eyes on the clouds like I was raised to do.

lines.en: : It’s just, like...there are so many songs about true love and...{i}falling{/i} in love...{i}being{/i} in love...the things that {i}love{/i} can make you do...and I, like...{i}can’t{/i} write those. And that {i}sucks.{/i}

lines.zh: : 生活和音乐里有那么一整个面向，是我{i}想{/i}去理解的。可每次我一{i}试着{/i}去理解，我就想把自己的头发他妈的一根根拔光。

lines.en: : But Niki gets that. And despite what the Internet might say about idol culture and shit, she’s a {i}real{/i} artist. She writes her own music...lyrics...and it’s all so {i}personal,{/i} but...{i}accessible{/i} too.
lines.zh: : 可 Niki 懂。而且不管网上怎么说偶像文化什么的，她是个{i}真正的{/i}艺术家。她自己写歌……写词……一切都那么{i}私人{/i}，可又那么{i}平易近人{/i}。

lines.en: : And you figure she’d be able to show you more of that world?
lines.zh: : 所以你觉得她能带你看到那个世界更多东西？

lines.en: scene otohamcds25
: I {i}think{/i} so? But I also can’t look at her without wanting her to push me to the ground and have her way with me. So that’s a world I want to be a part of too, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我{i}想{/i}是吧？可我看着她的时候，又忍不住想让她把我按在地上随心所欲。所以那个世界我也想进去，大概吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, I like that world a little more.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个世界我更喜欢一点。

lines.en: scene otohamcds26
: Do you really, though? Because, and this is older-sister Otoha speaking now, what if you’re only {i}this{/i} fucked up {i}because{/i} that’s the world you’re living in?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？因为——现在是姐姐版 Otoha 在说话了——万一你之所以{i}这么{/i}一团糟，{i}正是因为你{/i}活在那个世界里呢？

lines.en: : What if you’re like me in that regard? Aware that there’s this extra dimension that could make your life so much better, and you’re just...infinitely stumbling while trying to make it there?
lines.zh: : 万一你在这方面跟我一样？明明知道有那么一个额外的维度能让你的人生好得多，可你就是……在通往那里的路上无止境地摔跤？

lines.en: : I think that’s just what living is.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那本来就是活着的样子。

lines.en: : This isn’t living. What {i}we’re{/i} doing isn’t living. Look at Niki. Look at Rin. They {i}know{/i} who they are. And yeah, they’ve got their problems as well, but do you think {i}they’re{/i} worried about this shit?
lines.zh: : 这不是活着。{i}我们{/i}现在做的这些不是活着。看看 Niki，看看 Rin。她们{i}知道{/i}自己是谁。她们当然也有自己的问题，可你觉得{i}她们{/i}会为这些破事发愁吗？

lines.en: : Hell no. They’ve got their own values and...people they care about and...there’s no fear of what lies {i}beyond{/i} any invisible forcefield since they’ve already passed through them all.
lines.zh: : 才不会。她们有自己的价值观……有自己在乎的人……而且她们早就穿过了所有那些无形的力场，根本不怕{i}墙那边{/i}有什么。

lines.en: : Can we really say we’re {i}living{/i} before we have the faintest idea what our lives even {i}are?{/i}
lines.zh: : 在我们连自己的人生到底{i}是{/i}什么都毫无概念之前，我们真能说自己在{i}活着{/i}吗？

lines.en: : I know what {i}my{/i} life is, Otoha. You-
lines.zh: : 我知道{i}我的{/i}人生是什么，Otoha。你——

lines.en: scene otohamcds27
: No! That’s- ugh! See, this is why you’re so annoying.
lines.zh: : 不！那是——啊！你看，你就是这么讨人厌。

lines.en: : It’s that, like...fatalist mindset of yours. That “I’ve fallen too far and can’t possibly climb back up” bullshit that people who {i}give up{/i} cling to.
lines.zh: : 就是……你那套宿命论。那套"我已经掉得太深，不可能再爬上去了"的鬼话，只有{i}放弃{/i}的人才会死抱着不放。

lines.en: : It’d be so fucking easy for me to do the same god damn thing. To just be, like “{i}Oh, I’m a bad person. I guess I’m just going to suck forever,{/i}” and then live out the rest of my life as a loser-douche hybrid.
lines.zh: : 我他妈也能轻而易举地做同样的事。就这么说一句"{i}哦，我是个坏人。看来我这辈子就这么烂下去了{/i}"，然后以一个废物加混蛋的杂交体过完余生。

lines.en: scene otohamcds28
: But I want to be more than that. And {i}you{/i} should want to be more than that.
lines.zh: : 可我想成为比那更多的东西。而{i}你{/i}也该想成为比那更多的东西。

lines.en: : Because if we don’t get our shit together, we’re {i}both{/i} going to wind up masturbating in front of people we care about. And not in a good way!
lines.zh: : 因为如果我们不把自己的破事收拾好，我们{i}俩{/i}最后都会在自己乎的人面前自慰。而且不是那种好的方式！

lines.en: : That took a weird turn.
lines.zh: : 这话说得有点怪。

lines.en: : I’m trying!
lines.zh: : 我在努力了！

lines.en: : Did you wash your hands?
lines.zh: : 你洗手了吗？

lines.en: : Yes!
lines.zh: : 洗了！

lines.en: : Otoha...
lines.zh: : Otoha……

lines.en: : Akira.
lines.zh: : Akira。

lines.en: : I really do like you, you know.
lines.zh: : 我是真的喜欢你，你知道吗。

lines.en: scene otohamcds29
: No matter how nicely you ask, I will not let you watch me again. And no, I am not sorry.
lines.zh: : 不管你问得多好听，我都不会再让你看了。还有，不，我不觉得抱歉。

lines.en: : That’s not what I’m getting at. I just appreciate that you can still find the time to talk to me like this despite having no clue what’s going on in your own life.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。我只是很感激，尽管你连自己的人生里发生了什么都搞不清楚，却还能抽出时间这样跟我说话。

lines.en: scene otohamcds30
: You don’t have to thank me. Just...reciprocate it. Because that’s all I’ve ever wanted from you.
lines.zh: : 你不用谢我。只要……也这样对我。因为这是我一直以来唯一想从你这里得到的东西。

lines.en: scene otohamcds31
: I don’t feel comfortable talking to my parents about shit like this. And it’s not like I can vent to Niki about how badly I want her to tackle me.
lines.zh: : 这种事我跟父母说不出口。而且我也没法跟 Niki 倾诉我有多想被她扑倒。

lines.en: : So for the most part, I’ve always just figured shit out on my own. But I’ve always wanted someone to, like...{i}be there.{/i} You know? Whether it be trading advice or...just {i}listening.{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以大多数时候，我一直都是自己一个人把破事想通的。可我一直想要有个人，能……{i}在{/i}那儿。你懂吧？不管是交换建议，还是……只是{i}听着{/i}。

lines.en: : And a teacher made the most sense. Like...I don’t have any siblings...and everyone {i}my{/i} age just wants to fuck me.
lines.zh: : 而老师最说得通。比如……我没有兄弟姐妹……而{i}跟我{/i}同龄的人都只想操我。

lines.en: scene otohamcds32
: Which, to be fair, you do as well. But I’m willing to overlook that if it means being able to come to you when I need something.
lines.zh: : 公平点说，你也一样。不过要是这意味着我可以在需要的时候来找你，我愿意睁一只眼闭一只眼。
: 找你做点——

lines.en: : Something that {i}isn’t{/i} sex.
lines.zh: : 做点{i}不是{/i}性的事。

lines.en: : You’ve had other teachers before, Otoha. Were none of them up to your {i}standards?{/i} Or are you just {i}settling{/i} for me now like you did with Rin?
lines.zh: : 你以前也有过别的老师，Otoha。就没有一个能达到你的{i}标准{/i}吗？还是说你现在像对 Rin 一样，在{i}将就{/i}我？

lines.en: scene otohamcds33
: I’ve never had a teacher like {i}you{/i} before. And that’s both a good and a bad thing.
lines.zh: : 我从来没有过像{i}你{/i}这样的老师。这既是好事也是坏事。

lines.en: : It’s {i}bad{/i} because, like I just mentioned, you want to fuck me. {i}And{/i} everyone else. And I’m sure I don’t have to tell you why that is wrong.
lines.zh: : 说它{i}坏{/i}，是因为就像我刚才说的，你想操我。{i}还有{/i}其他所有人。我想我不用告诉你为什么这不对。

lines.en: : But it’s {i}good{/i} because you’re the first person who isn’t constantly reminding me that I can do better.
lines.zh: : 但说它{i}好{/i}，是因为你是第一个不会一直提醒我"你可以做得更好"的人。

lines.en: : And yeah, that might be sort of counterintuitive to the whole “being a teacher” thing. But at the end of the day, your job is to {i}inspire.{/i} And being reminded of how talented I am isn’t inspiring. It’s {i}tiring.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊，这可能跟"当老师"这件事有点背道而驰。但说到底，你的工作是{i}激励{/i}。而被提醒自己多有才华并不激励人，那是{i}累人{/i}。

lines.en: : You look at me like a person, not a student. So maybe what I wanted wasn’t a teacher at all.
lines.zh: : 你看我的眼神像是在看一个人，而不是一个学生。所以也许我想要的从来就不是老师。

lines.en: : It was a friend.
lines.zh: : 而是一个朋友。

lines.en: : That was really fucking lame, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 这他妈也太肉麻了，Otoha。

lines.en: scene otohamcds34
: Yeah, I’m cringing pretty hard right now, not gonna lie.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我现在正尴尬得起鸡皮疙瘩，不骗你。

lines.en: : No, I just mean you missed another good opportunity to call me your brother.
lines.zh: : 不，我只是说你又错过了一个叫我哥哥的好机会。

lines.en: : That was on purpose. I didn’t want you to make things sexual again.
lines.zh: : 那是故意的。我不想让你又把事情往性那边带。

lines.en: : A-hah. So you admit you’re what the kids would call a “brocon.”
lines.zh: : 啊哈。那你就是承认了，用现在小孩的话说，你是个"兄控"。

lines.en: scene otohamcds35
: I don’t like that you know that word.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你居然知道这个词。

lines.en: : Good. Because, while I’ll always be here for you to {i}trade advice{/i} with, I’m going to make it even more of a point to make your life a living hell from now on.
lines.zh: : 很好。因为，虽然我永远都会在这里跟你{i}交换建议{/i}，但从现在起，我会更加变本加厉地把你的生活变成人间地狱。

lines.en: : Meaning what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体是什么意思？

lines.en: scene black
: Meaning we’ll figure this shit out together.
lines.zh: : 意思是我们一起把这些破事想明白。

lines.en: : That...what does that have to do with the “living hell” part? What are you going to do to me?
lines.zh: : 那……这跟"人间地狱"有什么关系？你要对我做什么？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. But it looks like we’ll have to find out next time since the scene has already faded to black.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。不过看来我们得下次再知道了，因为这一幕已经淡出到黑屏了。

lines.en: : Wha- what scene?! We’re in fucking McDonald’s! Stop being weird!
lines.zh: : 什么——什么幕？！我们他妈的在麦当劳！别这么怪！

lines.en: : {i}At the time, we had no idea...but that conversation would change everything. It was truly the beginning...of something wonderful.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}当时我们并不知道……但那场对话改变了一切。那真的是开端……属于某个美妙事物的开端。{/i}

lines.en: : Stop narrating our conversation! And eat your fucking French fries!
lines.zh: : 别给我们的对话配音！把你他妈的薯条吃了！

lines.en: Otoha begins throwing food at my head.
lines.zh: Otoha 开始往我头上扔吃的。

lines.en: And I open up some more space in my decaying heart for her.
lines.zh: 而我在那颗日渐腐朽的心里，又为她腾出了一些空间。
